name: filters_sort
title: Filters Sort
description: Sort row (Sort by + Order selects) and its toggle button for a filters form. Reorders the <li> items of the linked listing (<ul id="{target}">). Columns auto-detected from the field count via utility_grid_listing (or utility_grid_column_balancing), also offered to the filters row (grid_attrs). Used by filters_post_projects and hobby_pc_video_games_filters.
